answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a radiation-hardened compute bus attestation whose fault-tolerant quorum logs every ephemeris-tracking heartbeat, so forged nodes cannot masquerade as an ivory oasis of trust. Colluding identities must instead stake capital at the wharf of a shared ledger, where cross-attestation divergence triggers slashing. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
